data.name: Amin
data.gender_notes: Amin is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n), 'to be safe, trustworthy'. Amīn means 'trustworthy'. Its root is أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n). An epithet of the Prophet ﷺ (al-Amīn, 'the trustworthy'). Amin is a Arabic name meaning “Trustworthy; faithful; safe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amin expresses “Trustworthy; faithful; safe”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n), 'to be safe, trustworthy'. Amīn means 'trustworthy'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amin total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
